## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical skill in handling schema drift and idempotent upserts in streaming Databricks pipelines.

## Key Concepts
- Schema drift and canonical schema design
- Struct payload encoding
- Idempotent MERGE pattern
- Streaming boundaries and data quality

## Code Example
```javascript
MERGE INTO Silver AS s
USING (SELECT tenant_id, event_id, event_ts, payload FROM Bronze) AS b
ON s.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND s.event_id = b.event_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET event_ts = b.event_ts, payload = b.payload
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (tenant_id, event_id, event_ts, payload) VALUES (b.tenant_id, b.event_id, b.event_ts, b.payload);
```

## Why This Is Asked

## Code Example

```javascript
import dlt

@dlt.table
def Bronze_raw():
  return spark.read.json("s3://bucket/logs/*/")

@dlt.table
def Silver_normalized(Bronze_raw):
  df = Bronze_raw
  df = df.withColumn("event_time_utc", F.to_utc_timestamp(F.col("event_time"), "UTC"))
  # flatten nested fields as needed
  return df.select("customer_id", "session_id", "event_type", "event_time_utc", "properties.*")

@dlt.table
def Gold_events(Silver_normalized):
  df = Silver_normalized
  df = df.withColumn("key", F.concat_ws("|", F.col("customer_id"), F.col("session_id"), F.col("event_time_utc")))
  return df
```
